subject.description: The subject line of the MIME message.

body.description: The text content of the first part of the message.

debug.description: Whether to enable debug output from mime-construct.

output.description: Whether to print the message to stdout instead of sending it.

cc.description: List of CC recipient email addresses.

bcc.description: List of BCC recipient email addresses.

headers.description: List of additional arbitrary header lines to include in the message.

multipart.description: The multipart content type. Empty string uses default multipart/mixed.

prelude.description: Text to prepend to the multipart message body.

attachments.description: List of file attachments to include in the message.

attachments.items.description: The file path to attach. mime-construct --file-attach handles type detection.
